frozen_input: First 128 whitespace tokens of target followed by first 16 whitespace tokens of source class identifier; NOT candidate-category conditioning.
split: Three deterministic count-balanced dependence-component folds; seven purged leave-one-project-out splits per language. Components link identical normalized targets or sources.
macro: All 5/6 labels, zero_division=0, pooled out-of-fold predictions.
bootstrap: 2000 paired original-comment percentile 95% draws conditional on predictions; linked-component sensitivity; no refits or multiplicity adjustment.
